title: Global blow-up
statement:
Let $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X)$ be the scheme produced by applying
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.glued` to the valid datum of
[def-nagata-global-blowup-glue-data].

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X)$ be the scheme obtained by gluing the
local models along the datum of [def-nagata-global-blowup-glue-data], that
is, the colimit of the diagram $V\mapsto\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)$ over the
affine opens $V$ of $X$.
blueprint_update.note: the current blueprint (aligned 2026-10-15 with the six-functors notes) states or proves this differently; a worker who touches the node follows it
